items.stem: A CI ServiceAccount only needs to read Pods in one namespace. Which approach follows least privilege?

options.text: A Role granting get/list on pods, bound with a RoleBinding in that namespace
options.rationale: Correct: a namespaced Role with only the needed verbs, bound via RoleBinding, is least privilege.

options.text: A ClusterRole granting cluster-admin bound cluster-wide
options.rationale: cluster-admin grossly over-grants and violates least privilege.

options.text: Mounting the default ServiceAccount token everywhere
options.rationale: That expands exposure rather than restricting it.
Disabling RBAC removes authorization controls entirely.

items.explanation: Correct: a namespaced Role with only the needed verbs, bound via RoleBinding, is least privilege.

items.stem: Which control provides the strongest workload isolation by running containers in a user-space kernel sandbox?

options.rationale: Correct: gVisor intercepts syscalls in a user-space kernel, giving stronger isolation than shared-kernel containers.
Probes check health and have no isolation function.
ConfigMaps hold configuration data, not isolation.
Scaling replicas does not isolate a workload from the host kernel.

items.explanation: Correct: gVisor intercepts syscalls in a user-space kernel, giving stronger isolation than shared-kernel containers.

items.stem: Which TWO practices strengthen the container image supply chain? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Scanning images for known CVEs before deployment
options.rationale: Correct: scanning catches known vulnerabilities before they ship.

options.text: Restricting clusters to pull only from a signed, trusted registry
options.rationale: Correct: an allowlist of signed registries blocks untrusted images.
That weakens security and is unrelated to image supply chain.

options.text: Disabling audit logging to reduce noise
options.rationale: Disabling audit logging reduces detection, it does not secure the supply chain.

options.text: Always using the latest tag so images auto-update
options.rationale: The latest tag is non-deterministic and undermines supply-chain integrity.

items.explanation: Correct: scanning catches known vulnerabilities before they ship.
